title: Claude Code adapter
description: Tap Claude Code on-disk history: JSONL transcripts under ~/.claude/projects (honors CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, plus archive roots). Extract ALL part types (user, assistant, thinking, tool calls and results, attachments), not only human messages. Reference: scanner-sentiment adapter, read-only.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scope note: this adapter epic is the per-agent translation of Chapter 3: Importers / Change Data Capture (epic BOTSPY-e0bcfa, features/03_importers). It owns only this agent's side of the CDC pipeline — watching the source and emitting normalized records as they appear — not the pipeline mechanics, which live in Chapter 3. Parenting stays on initiative BOTSPY-65cc21 per board rules.

right_now_summary: The Claude Code adapter is being tested for transcript discovery, parsing, parity, and diagnostic coverage.
